advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.ro: Pick up a pebble. Age 0 begins on the ground.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.fl: Craft a flint knife. Cut fibre, hunt, and scrape hides — binding comes next.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.pl: Gather plant fibre from grass. Twist it into string for rope, snares, and a bow-and-drill.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.fi: Animals drop raw leather. Hang it on a tanning rack out of the rain.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.ta: Finish a hide on the rack. Cut strips to haft bone tools, craft a hide bed, or make a leather skin.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.ha: Bind a bone axe. Fell logs, hew a work stump, and leave stick-and-thatch behind.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.wo: Hew and lash a work stump. Real crafting starts here — and wears the stump down.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.ma: Burn a charcoal pile with a bow-and-drill. Charcoal fuels clay firing next.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.fi: Fire wet clay bricks in a drying pit. Bricks build a basic smelter.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.ba: Build a basic smelter. Ore waits for Age 1 — start looking for zinc.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.se: Craft a snare or fish trap. Bait it, leave, and collect while you sleep.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.sh: Sleep under a roof. Craft a hide bed — wool beds are gated.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.se: A camp that works while you are away: tools, hidework, fire, a trap, a bed, and a work stump.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age1.fi: Alloy copper and zinc into a bronze ingot. Soft metal opens the workshop.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age1.ha: Haft a bronze sword, pick, axe, shovel, hoe, spear, or hammer. The pick reaches further than bone. Iron ore is still too hard.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age1.wh: Raise a water wheel in flowing water and let the current turn it.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age1.un: Drive a powered quern to finish a grind, or a trip hammer to finish a forging.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age1.ho: Pump the bellows on a lit forge. The draft stretches the fire.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age1.br: A hafted bronze tool, a machine that finished its work, and a bellows-fed forge.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age1.ir: Dig up rusty mud. That stain is the way to iron. Iron ore itself waits for a harder pick.
advancements.from-stone-to-stars.age0.zi: Mine raw zinc with a bone pick. Bronze — zinc and copper — opens Age 1.

Ironworks fittings, ore crusher, sawmill, and bore rig
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.tanning_rac: Hang raw leather on the rack. After five minutes each hide becomes leather. Keep it under cover — rain resets drying progress. Take finished leather with an empty hand, or sneak to remove everything.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.kindling: Lights charcoal piles and brick drying pits. Charcoal: one log with four kindling. Pottery: five kindling (center plus four around it), unfired clay ware (bricks, jug, or storage pot) above the center, and four coal or charcoal blocks on the outer kindling. Light any kindling with a bow and drill.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bow_and_dri: Age 0 fire starter. Lights a charcoal pile or a brick drying pit. Four uses.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.charcoal_bl: Made in a charcoal pile, not a furnace. Crafts back into charcoal. Used with coal blocks as the cover on a brick drying pit.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bone_saw: Use on top of a log to place the saw. Right-click the placed saw to cut the log into 4 matching planks. The saw is returned.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.raw_leather: Dropped by animals instead of leather. Dry it on a tanning rack before cutting strips.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.pebble: Found on the ground. Nine pebbles compact into cobblestone. One cobblestone splits back into pebbles.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bark: Strip a log with any axe. Two bark and two sticks craft kindling.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.work_stump: Strip a log, then axe the stripped log again to hew an unfinished stump. Bind it with one leather strip to finish. Opens the same 3×3 crafting as a table. Each craft can wear the stump until it breaks.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.forging_stu: Craft from four bronze and a work stump. Open it, put in heated bronze, heated copper, heated iron, dried rusty mud, or raw iron, copper, gold, or zinc, and pick a recipe. The tooltip shows how many of that item the recipe costs and how many hammer hits it takes. Then hit the stump with a bronze or iron hammer. An empty input keeps the last recipe, so the next matching stack starts that craft again. Heated metal keeps cooling on the stump — work fast. One raw ore takes sixteen hits and becomes two crushed pieces. Take the result from the output slot. A hopper can insert into a side and pull from the bottom. The top stays closed, because that is where the trip hammer sits.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.crushed_iro: Sixteen hammer hits crush one raw iron into two of these. Smelt each piece into an iron ingot. Smelting is their only use.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.crushed_cop: Sixteen hammer hits crush one raw copper into two of these. Smelt each piece into a copper ingot. Smelting is their only use.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.crushed_gol: Sixteen hammer hits crush one raw gold into two of these. Smelt each piece into a gold ingot. Smelting is their only use.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.crushed_zin: Sixteen hammer hits crush one raw zinc into two of these. Smelt each piece into a zinc ingot. Smelting is their only use.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.trip_hammer: Place on a forging stump, with a wooden axle into the back. A water wheel turns it. The head drops about four times every three seconds and strikes the recipe selected on the stump. A hopper into a side of the stump can load it, and a hopper under the stump can take the result. The top of the stump stays closed for this hammer.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.powered_que: A water wheel turns it, with the axle into the back. Put a grindable item in by hand, or with a hopper into the top or a side. A hopper underneath takes the result. It grinds while the axle is turning. Sneak with an empty hand to take everything out.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bronze_hopp: Craft from five bronze ingots and a bronze chest. It moves items only while a water wheel is turning it, one item every 16 ticks, half the speed of an iron hopper. A shaft can meet any face except the top and the spout. It draws one turn from the wheel.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.unfinished_: Hewn from a stripped log. Use a leather strip to lash the top and turn it into a work stump.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.hammerstone: Crafted from a pebble. Breaks gravel and is used to sharpen bone. It has two uses.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bronze_hamm: Craft from a bronze ingot and a stick. Hit a forging stump to work the recipe selected in its menu. Breaks gravel into flint, the same as a hammerstone, and wears by one use.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bronze_buck: Craft from three bronze ingots. Picks up and places water, lava, and powder snow, fills from cauldrons, and works from a dispenser. Milk cows and goats; the milk clears effects and bakes a cake. A water bucket scoops fish, tadpoles, and axolotls, and feeds a nautilus. An empty bucket scoops sulfur cubes. Lava fuels a furnace, and a wet sponge fills the empty bucket with water. You get the bronze bucket back.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.iron_hammer: Craft from an iron tool head, a nail, and a stick. Hit a forging stump the same way as a bronze hammer, and breaks gravel into flint. It lasts longer and repairs with an iron ingot.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.iron_knife: Craft from an iron tool head, a nail, and a stick. A short iron blade: a little faster and a little lighter than an iron sword. Cutting leather returns the knife one use more worn.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.clay_bricks: Craft two clay balls into wet bricks. Fire them in a basic smelter / blast furnace, or in a drying pit: five kindling, wet clay bricks above the center, four coal or charcoal blocks on the outer kindling. Light with a bow and drill. Takes five minutes in the pit. Fired piles drop vanilla brick items.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.unfired_cla: Craft from five clay balls in a jug shape. Fire in a drying pit (same layout as bricks) or blast furnace to get a clay jug.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.clay_jug: Fired clay water vessel. Holds 64 uses — a full stack. Fill from a water source or cauldron. Does not place water. Crafts dough with flour like a leather skin.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.unfired_sto: Craft from eight clay balls. Fire in a drying pit or blast furnace. Fragile once fired.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.storage_pot: Fired clay barrel: 27 slots. Needs a solid block underneath or it falls and shatters, spilling contents. Only drops itself with silk touch; otherwise it breaks.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bronze_ches: Craft from planks, nails, and leather strips. Holds 27 stacks. Two bronze chests facing the same way join into a large chest. They do not connect to a vanilla chest.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.brick: Same item as vanilla brick. Only made from wet clay bricks — blast them in a basic smelter / blast furnace, or fire a pile in a drying pit. Placing a brick builds the modded fired pile (stack up to three). Four bricks still craft a normal bricks block. Used to craft a basic smelter.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.basic_smelt: A slow clay blast furnace. Smelts blasting recipes (ores) at half speed, fires charged crucibles into alloys, and heats bronze/copper ingots for working. Heated metal stays hot in the smelter; once removed it cools for 1 minute back into a normal ingot. Craft from brick items and a charcoal block.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.crucible: Craft from five wet clay bricks in a U. Pack with metals on a work stump (for bronze: four copper + one zinc). Fire the charged crucible in a basic smelter, blast furnace, or lit forge. Breaks after eight firings.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bronze_rein: Pack and fire it the same way as a clay crucible. The charged crucible comes back one use more worn, and it lasts thirty-two firings.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.mortar_and_: Place an input, then right-click with an empty hand to grind. Four clicks convert one item. Recipes are datapack grinding recipes, so other grinders can share them. Sneak to take everything out.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.flour: Grind wheat in a mortar and pestle. Mix with water from a leather skin or clay jug to make dough.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.snare: Place bait, then leave. Plant bait (seeds, wheat, fibre) catches small game. Meat bait catches larger game. Up to 16 bait. Empty-hand takes catch; sneak takes catch and leftover bait. Works while you are away — nearby players scare game off(24 Blocks).
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.fish_trap: Place in water with fishing bait, then leave. Catches fish over time. Up to 16 bait. Empty-hand takes catch; sneak takes catch and leftover bait. Nearby players scare fish off (24 blocks).
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.hide_bed: Age 0 bed. Craft from three leather and three wheat. Sleeps and sets spawn like a vanilla bed. Wool beds are gated.
multiblock.from-stone-to-stars.forge_rea: Forge structure complete — light to start

multiblock.from-stone-to-stars.rule.fuel: At least 4 coal or charcoal blocks under the hearth (within 2 blocks)
multiblock.from-stone-to-stars.rule.bell: A bellows within 2 blocks facing the hearth
multiblock.from-stone-to-stars.rule.sawm: A saw arbor facing a 1–3 wide, 2–3 high wall of steel saw blades with framed sides and top, 1–4 rows of wooden rollers on each side of the blades, and a row of log intakes on one end and plank outfeeds on the other

jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.forge_heart: Build a brick/cobble-framed forge: 1×1–5×5 coal on a framed base, 1×1–5×5 hearths on the centre coal (shared inventory; smelts blasting recipes and fires charged crucibles, starting slower than a blast furnace, and each extra hearth speeds it up), one bellows bank facing inward (rectangle OK), optional air access gap, and a framed air chimney at least 2 tall (1×1–3×3, may be offset). Light any hearth. Burn scales with coal (5 minutes for the minimum pad). Pump bellows to refill toward that max. Use a steel sheet on a hearth to line it: each steel-lined hearth adds as much speed as another hearth.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.saw_arbor: Heart of the sawmill. Place it facing into a wall of steel saw blades 1–3 wide and 2–3 high. Frame the far side of the blades, the arbor's column above or below it, and a beam across the top, using logs, planks, cobblestone, or stone bricks. At the bottom of each blade column, run 1–4 rows of wooden rollers out both ways along the line. End one side with full rows of log intakes and the other with full rows of plank outfeeds. Turn the arbor from the back with a water wheel and it assembles itself. Each log becomes 6 planks. Wider mills cut more logs at once and draw one turn per lane, and taller blades cut slightly faster. Click the arbor to see its status or why it won't form.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.steel_saw_b: Sawmill blades. Stack them 2–3 high in front of a saw arbor, up to 3 columns wide, all facing along the line. Each column is one lane that cuts its own log. The sides and top must be framed.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.wooden_roll: The sawmill's conveyor bed. Place them from the side so they line up along the line, in full rows below the blades: 1–4 rows on each side. Each roller adds one storage slot (16 logs on the intake side, a stack of planks on the outfeed side). Logs dropped on the infeed rollers are pulled in.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.log_intake: Ends the infeed roller bed of a sawmill. All intakes share one log store, so put logs in any of them by hand or with a hopper. You can stack up to 2 rows of intakes per infeed roller row, and each intake adds a 16-log slot.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.plank_outfe: Ends the outfeed roller bed of a sawmill. All outfeeds share one plank store. Click with an empty hand to take all planks, or pull them out with a hopper. You can stack up to 4 rows of outfeeds per outfeed roller row, and each outfeed adds a stack of storage.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.bellows: Fill exactly one side of the hearth cluster, facing the way you look (toward the hearth). Same-facing bellows connect like fences into a bank (wider, deeper, or stacked). Empty-hand click while the forge is lit to pump and extend burn time. Powered bellows can stand in the same bank.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.powered_bel: A steel-framed bellows for the forge's bellows bank. Place it like a bellows, facing the hearth, and run a wooden axle into the back. While a water wheel turns it, the forge's burn slowly climbs to the coal-pad maximum and stays there. If the wheel stops, the burn counts down as normal, and the fire still goes out at zero. It does not relight a cold forge. It can still be pumped by hand, and it draws one turn from the wheel.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.forge_input: Holds nine stacks for the forge. Build it into the frame beside the hearths, in place of a brick or cobble block. Players and hoppers can fill it from any side, but hoppers cannot pull from it. While the forge is lit, the hearth draws anything it can smelt or fire from its inputs, taking from each input in turn. Items it cannot use stay in the input. Before smelting, the forge checks crucible alloys, with no crucible needed: each ingredient has to sit in a different input, for example 4 copper in one and 1 zinc in another for 5 bronze. Steel also needs every hearth steel-lined.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.drill_head: The bore rig's controller. Put a rod rack on top, and an ore box and a drive housing on opposite sides. While the drive turns, it bores straight down one block every 3 seconds and fills the hole with drill string. Each steel drill rod buys 8 blocks of depth. It crosses caves and water, and stops at lava, bedrock, or blocks an iron pick can't break. When ore sits in the 3×3 ring around the hole, diagonals included, it mines the whole connected vein into the ore box, one ore every 2 seconds, and leaves stone or deepslate behind. Use it to see its status. Sneak-use with an empty hand to recall the string: the hole is sealed with stone, and each rod that went down has a 25% chance to break. Breaking the rig without recalling loses every rod that is down.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.rod_rack: Sits on top of the drill head and holds up to 8 steel drill rods. Stack up to 8 racks in a column for more rods; the drill takes from the top rack first and returns rods to the bottom rack first. Use it with rods to load them, or with an empty hand to take them back. Hoppers can load it.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.ore_box: Sits beside the drill head, opposite the drive housing. Ore from the bore rig lands here, mined as if with an iron pickaxe. Use it to open, sneak-use to take everything. Hoppers can pull from it.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.drive_housi: Sits beside the drill head, opposite the ore box. Run a wooden axle into its back. It draws one turn from the wheel.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.steel_drill: Forged on the stump from 2 heated steel ingots. Load it into a bore rig's rod rack; each rod lets the drill go 8 blocks deeper. Rods that go down can break when the drill is recalled.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.ore_crusher: Sits on top of a forge input. Run a wooden axle into the back. While a water wheel turns it, it crushes raw ore four times faster than a trip hammer, using the forging stump's crush recipes (1 raw ore for 2 crushed ore). Each strike counts as four hits, so one raw ore takes four strikes, and drops the crushed ore into the input below. Load it by hand, with a hopper from the top or sides, or by dropping ore onto it. Use it with an empty hand to take the ore back. It draws one turn from the wheel, and it works whether or not the forge is lit.
jei.from-stone-to-stars.info.tapping_spo: The forge's output. Build it into the frame beside the hearths or beside the coal pad, facing away from the forge. While the forge is lit, finished items move into it, and so do spent crucibles. With several spouts, they fill in turn. It holds nine stacks and pushes one item at a time into the block it faces, such as a chest, a hopper, or a forging stump. Hoppers can pull from any side. Use it to open it, or sneak-use with an empty hand to take everything. Heated metal stays hot inside.
